subject: Vendor onboarding: Velarium supplier profile + PO exceptions
messages:
From: Sophie Lange <sophie.lange@velarium.com>
To: avery.johnson@redwood.inference.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor registration for Redwood Inference - next steps

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week — procurement asked me to start the vendor registration for Redwood so we can route POs and process invoices. Two quick asks up front:

- Can you send an AP onboarding packet (template + W-9 / VAT docs) so my team can start the supplier profile?
- Our system requires a canonical legal entity name and an incorporation certificate (PDF). Can you confirm Redwood’s billed entity for invoices to Velarium?

Also, a couple policy notes from AP: invoices must include a PO number and the PO line description must match the goods/services taxonomy in our portal (we typically reject invoices where the PO line is generic). In EU cases, we sometimes need explicit VAT handling notes (reverse charge, VAT-exempt with evidence).

I’ve attached the Velarium supplier registration form — please complete and upload to the portal at: https://velarium.ariba.com/supplier/submit/XYZ-889.

Can you get this back to me by EOB Monday?

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Lange
Senior Procurement Manager | Velarium Corp
[Attachment: Vendor_Registration_Form_Velarium.pdf (PDF, 98KB)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Lange <sophie.lange@velarium.com>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor registration for Redwood Inference - next steps

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and the form. Looping in Rachel from Finance to help with the tax and bank details.

Short answers up front:
- Billed entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (legal name on incorporation doc)
- We can provide incorporation certificate, W-9 (US) and a current EU VAT certificate for the EU entity.
- We accept PO-based invoicing; our invoices will include the PO number in the header and each line will include the product code + brief description (we’ll mirror Velarium’s required taxonomy).

Attached: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (contains our sample invoice, preferred field mapping, and bank remittance). Also attached: Redwood_W9_2026.pdf and EU_VAT_Certificate_Redwood.pdf.

A couple quick clarifications so we don’t get rejected:
- Which legal entity should be entered into the portal for EU invoices? Velarium has asked some vendors to register the EU legal entity rather than the US parent to allow reverse-charge handling.
- Velarium’s PO terms in the portal — do you require Net30 by default or can we request Net45 for subscription invoices? We’re flexible but need to know for cashflow.

Next steps: we’ll complete the vendor registration form and upload the incorporation doc to your portal. Rachel — can you confirm bank validation steps?

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (PDF, 124KB)]

From: Sophie Lange <sophie.lange@velarium.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: James King <james.king@velarium.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor registration for Redwood Inference - next steps

Thanks, Avery — copying James from AP ops.

A couple more specifics from ops after quick review of your packet:
- For EU invoices we require the EU legal entity to be the registered supplier so our system can apply reverse-charge rules. If you bill from the US parent, we will require VAT evidence that no VAT is charged and an internal exception.
- We do allow Net45 for the first 3 invoices as an exception for new vendor/account setups, but that must be requested in the portal; otherwise default is Net30.
- Vendor profile must include: Tax/VAT ID, bank details (IBAN for SEPA), and a standard commodity classification. For subscriptions we accept the class 'SaaS - Cloud Services' but the PO line must contain the phrase 'SaaS subscription - inference platform' to map correctly.

Please fill the registry form and attach the incorporation doc and VAT cert. James — can you confirm whether we need vendor bank validation (micro-deposit) for international suppliers?

Best,
Sophie
[Attachment: Vendor_Registration_Form_Velarium.pdf (PDF, 98KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Lange <sophie.lange@velarium.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 07:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration for Redwood Inference - next steps

Hi Sophie — Marissa (Finance) here. Thanks for the details. A few items from our side to avoid a common rejection:

1) Bank verification: we prefer the micro-deposit flow but can also provide a bank letter. I’m attaching our bank verification instructions for Velarium ops if needed.

2) Invoice template: please validate that the following fields will be accepted in your portal (we included them in the AP packet):
   - Invoice number
   - Invoice date
   - PO number (required)
   - Supplier legal name (must exactly match registry)
   - Supplier tax/VAT id
   - Line-level commodity code + description (e.g., 'SaaS - Cloud Services; product: Redwood inference runtime')
   - Net amount, VAT (if applicable), Total due

3) Tax handling for EU: if Velarium requires the EU subsidiary entry, we will register that entity and provide the VAT certificate. If Velarium will accept reverse-charge with the US entity, we need the portal field that captures "reverse charge applied - yes/no" or a freeform tax note area.

Finally, for the Net45 exception — happy to accept that for first 3 invoices but would like confirmatory language on the supplier portal (i.e. field where you record payment term exceptions).

Attachments: bank-verification-instructions.pdf, Incorporation_US_Inc_2024.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bank-verification-instructions.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]
[Attachment: Incorporation_US_Inc_2024.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

From: James King <james.king@velarium.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Sophie Lange <sophie.lange@velarium.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor registration for Redwood Inference - next steps

Marissa — thanks, that helps. Quick answers from AP ops:
- We do a soft micro-deposit validation for international bank routing. If Redwood prefers, we can accept a bank letter reviewed by our treasury.
- The portal has a freeform "Tax notes" field where you can indicate reverse-charge or VAT exemption, and we will attach that to the supplier record.
- We will enter a temporary payment-term exception (Net45) for three invoices; the portal will show the exception under 'Payment Terms' once set.

Sophie and Avery — to finalize: please upload the incorporation PDF, VAT certificate (if registering EU entity), and the AP packet. Once our team approves the profile (typically 3-5 business days), we’ll provide the vendor ID and you can submit a test invoice.

-James
James King
AP Operations | Velarium Corp
[Attachment: None]
Link to portal: https://velarium.ariba.com/supplier/submit/XYZ-889

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.inference.com>

- Redwood: we’ll wait for the vendor ID to schedule first month’s invoice (we bill monthly in arrears).
